prompt: A hand pressing a wax seal onto a folded letter on a writing desk: the envelope lies flat with a pool of sealing wax at its flap, the hand grips an ornate brass seal stamp above the wax, an inkwell with a quill, a small stack of waiting letters and a candlestick sit at the edges of the desk. The hand presses the seal down onto the wax at the centre of the plate.
